_note: LEAN scenario overrides: less clay doing the same job, less handling, capital-light plant. Mass factors marked TO-DESIGN are design targets, not yet checked structures.

mass_factor_src.wall: graded 6 in unit meets U target at ~86 vs 133 kg/m2 (thermal_check.py)
mass_factor_src.dome: ribbed dome, 8-10 post-tensioned ribs + 6 in graded webs: 35% less dome clay; passes every load case (dome_ribbed.py)
mass_factor_src.drainage: fired apron/collector/drain tile replaced by a gravel drip trench dug on site (buyer's site work)

capex_factor_src: used extruders/forklifts, open sheds, a zigzag/Hoffmann kiln built from the plant's own bricks, owner-built solar [UNSOURCED -> quotes]
variable_src: labor: robotic line 1.9 h/t .. semi-automated 4.9 h/t (production_line.py)

steel_design._src: 60x8 flat bar instead of C100 (ring 20 kN vs ~120 kN capacity); one wedged key per fold (top bar + base slider tie the rest); extruded fired-clay siding rails with cut notches replace steel rails + battens
